text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, phenytoin sodium 100 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 165 capsules (21.5 days at 7.7/day). Corvale General holds 253 capsules (30.6 days at 8.3/day). Corvale Lakeside holds 23 capsules (13.2 days at 1.7/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include phenytoin sodium as of 2026-10-21. The label for NDC 50090353900 names A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-08-12. A-S Medication Solutions received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05 and its most recent inspection was classified VAI on 2026-08-12.

Our position: Current inventory covers 13 to 31 days across sites. Lakeside is lowest at 13.2 days. No FDA shortage listing exists. Multiple alternate suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC for all three sites; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Aurobindo Pharma Limited as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate AvPAK, Coupler LLC, and Major Pharmaceuticals for pricing and lead time; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes at next P&T meeting; requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
